public.title: Class Manipulation
public.description: initial is a list of distinct class names. Apply ["add",name], ["remove",name], or ["toggle",name]. Ignore duplicate adds; new classes append; removal preserves remaining order. Return class-list snapshots after each operation. Supported inputs contain at most 100 array entries per sequence and at most 20 operations or requests per sequence, at most 60 total object properties and array elements in any single JSON value, nesting depth at most 8, strings at most 100 ASCII characters unless specified otherwise, and integers from -100 through 100 unless a tighter or explicit alternate bound is stated. The entire argument JSON encoding is at most 1000 bytes. Nested sequences collectively have at most 100 entries; output snapshots therefore remain bounded. Inputs always satisfy the described shape and bounds.
hints: Toggle removes an existing class and appends an absent class.
Check the public examples against the documented empty-input and boundary rules.

explanation: Maintain ordered unique classes, filtering removals and copying each snapshot. O(n squared) worst-case time and output space over n operations. This JSON adapter verifies observable results; it does not establish built-in-method restrictions, garbage collection, browser behavior or real timer/microtask scheduling.
